name: Kameko
source: A Kameko type monster girl. This Kameko lives at the beach and is a very strong fighter. Her shell is also incredibly tough which makes her almost impossible to harm however she's so shy that it's easy for [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] to defeat and capture her.
translation: A Kameko type monster girl. This Kameko lives at the beach and is a very strong fighter. Her shell is also incredibly tough which makes her almost impossible to harm however she's so shy that it's easy for [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] to defeat and capture her.
